title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E4 — Botulism
An injured cameraman proves to have more than a broken leg, leading Brackett to search for a botulism source; guest Susan Seaforth.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E5 — Cook's Tour
DeSoto and Gage deliver a baby over the father's protests; DeSoto worries about a dinner he is planning for the station-house crew.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E6 — Brushfire
A canyon fire threatens the residents of a housing development and keeps the paramedics on round-the-clock duty; guest Tony Dow.

title: The A-Team
description:
S3 E6 — Double Heat
The team interrupts a war between crime syndicates to rescue a government witness's (Dana Elcar) daughter (Leah Ayres).

title: The A-Team
description:
S3 E7 — Trouble on Wheels
B.A., Hannibal and cohorts infiltrate a car factory to capture a gang of ruthless auto-parts thieves.

title: The A-Team
description:
S3 E8 — The Island
Drug smugglers operating from a tropical island hold the team's former Vietnam medic (James Callahan) captive.

title: The A-Team
description:
S3 E9 — Showdown!
A gang of toughs jeopardizes the team's reputation by posing as the four and terrorizing rodeo performers and spectators.

title: The A-Team
description:
S3 E10 — Sheriffs of Rivertown
A U.S. oil company wants order restored in a makeshift community housing workers for a South American electrical-power plant.

title: The A-Team
description:
S3 E11 — The Bells of St. Mary's
An all-girl band from Face's old orphanage hires the team to go after a corrupt record-company executive (Robert Desiderio).

title: The A-Team
description:
S3 E12 — Hot Styles
The team infiltrates the fashion world to rescue Face's girlfriend (Markie Post) from her kidnapper (Richard Lynch).

title: The A-Team
description:
S3 E13 — Breakout!
Hannibal devises an elaborate escape plan after B.A. and Murdock are mistaken for accomplices in a robbery and sentenced to work on a chain gang.

title: The A-Team
description:
S3 E14 — Cup A'Joe
B.A. and Murdock help a diner owner and his daughter fight a corrupt tycoon who wants their land for an off-ramp.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S2 E11 — Escape From Los Santos
Banner and a widow (Shelley Fabares) are framed for the murder of the woman's husband.
